text: OVERDOSAGE Clinically apparent signs and symptoms of an overdose of TOBRADEX (tobramycin and dexamethasone ophthalmic ointment) (punctate keratitis, erythema, increased lacrimation, edema and lid itching) may be similar to adverse reaction effects seen in some patients.

OVERDOSAGE Clinically apparent signs and symptoms of an overdosage of TOBRADEX Ophthalmic Suspension (punctate keratitis, erythema, increased lacrimation, edema and lid itching) may be similar to adverse reaction effects seen in some patients.
